text:
Alex S: Heads-up — VectorIQ renewal came in. Usage up ~3.5x after POC. They want a quote to rebaseline committed units and negotiate uplift. Have security questionnaire still open. Any initial thoughts?

Maria (Sales): Do we have current ratecard and previous commit? They were on 750k tokens/mo commit at $0.0006/token. Now they're showing ~2.6M avg. Thinking 20% uplift on list but need dealdesk signoff.

Sam (Eng): Confirmed — POC switched to Dedicated for latency, KV cache hit rate improved. If we recommend Dedicated reserved pool, estimate extra infra delta ~ $5k/mo for the committed profile. Also recommend quantized model variant for cost.

Josh (DealDesk): Put together rationale for uplift: usage lift + added SLA and dedicated infra. We can consider stepped commit with blended rate. Need CFO approval for >25% uplift. Please include proposed tiers. Examples:
```
Tier A: 900k commit -> $0.00055/token
Tier B: 2.0M commit -> $0.00045/token
Tier C: 3.5M commit -> $0.00038/token
```
We can offer 3mo rate lock and then reevaluate.

Kate (CS): Customer health is good but PS hours consumed during POC. Recommend $15k one-time credit for onboarding + 10% first-year discount to retain. Also flag that security questionnaire (SOC2 questions) must be answered before Private deployment.

Alex S: @Josh can you run the discount against our margin thresholds? @Maria can you confirm the customer's preferred cadence (monthly vs annual)? I'll draft external email once we land on numbers.

procurement-bot: Ticket #PRQ-8791 created for "VectorIQ renewal uplift request" — assignee: @josh_dealdesk.

Josh (DealDesk): Running the margin calc now. Early read: with the onboarding credit + 10% off list we still preserve ~18% gross margin if they pick Tier B. If they want Tier C we need exec approval.

Maria (Sales): Customer prefers annual invoicing but can do quarterly if needed. Asking customer for 30-day extension on current term while we finalize.

Sam (Eng): Also note: if they accept quantized model variant we can lower token cost by ~12% without changing SLA; include as option.

Alex S: Ok, action items: @josh prepare deal desk package (margin calc + A/B/C tiers + exec note), @maria send provisional extension email & ask about annual vs quarterly, @kate draft onboarding credit note, @sam attach tech delta and quantized cost numbers. Target: have proposal to customer by EOD Thursday. :thumbsup:
